name: Still to motion reveal
looks: A frame holds on what reads as a static photo, held just a beat too long to be sure, then it quietly starts moving, revealing it was secretly a video clip all along. A short caption names the shift after motion has already begun.
build: Open on a single frame held static 400-600ms before playback starts, so the cut from photo to video is really playback starting late. The giveaway motion is subtle and physical (breathing, hair, a slow push-in), not an obvious effect. Caption fades in low in the frame after motion has already started.
sound: Silence or near-silence during the photo hold, ambient sound fading up the instant motion starts.
prompt: Hold on what looks like a still photo a beat too long, then let it quietly start moving with subtle, physical motion so the viewer realises it was secretly video all along, and only then fade in a short caption confirming the shift.
